title: Smt. Usha Shukla v. State of U.P. And 3 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J. and Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; 6.5 objection to be decided in six weeks; disconnection stayed.
headnote: Where a consumer's objection under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 remains undecided, the High Court directed the authority to decide it preferably within six weeks and stayed disconnection of the petitioner's supply until that decision.
facts: Smt. Usha Shukla filed a writ petition before the Allahabad High Court alleging that an objection she had raised under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 had not been decided by the concerned electricity authority. Counsel for the petitioner and for respondent nos. 2 to 4 were heard. The petition did not invite adjudication of the underlying billing dispute; the grievance was the pending 6.5 objection and the risk that the petitioner's electricity connection would be disconnected while that objection remained unattended.

holding_units.topic: pending 6.5 objection — time-bound decision; disconnection stayed
holding_units.holding: Where the petitioner's objection under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 has not been decided, the authority concerned is directed to decide that objection expeditiously, preferably within six weeks; until the 6.5 objection is decided, the petitioner's electricity connection shall not be disconnected. The writ petition is disposed of on those directions.

not_decided.note: The Court did not examine or decide the substance of the petitioner's billing objection.
